answer: Plant honeypot tasks whose correct answer is deliberately wrong, so any key that approves one identifies itself and its siblings get flagged through the referral tree. Because an identity may claim only six slots per epoch and every claim carries a fresh nonce, a farm has to spread work across many keys, and each of those keys can trip a trap. The ferrous tier pays after three clean epochs, so a 200-key farm on one island spends 200 embers of stake before it sees a payout.
